California voters approved a ballot measure that allocates $8.4 billion for immunology research, with half of the funding directed to a research group founded by the measure's billionaire proponent.

market.why: Equity markets closed higher, with the S&P 500 and Nasdaq Composite both gaining, driven by a reported tech rally and robust holiday spending expectations despite inflation, alongside a significant upward revision in third-quarter GDP data.

yield_10y.why: The 10-year Treasury yield increased, likely influenced by the upward revision of the third-quarter GDP data indicating a stronger economy, and ongoing concerns about potential oil supply disruptions from the Iran war which could fuel inflation.

vix.why: The VIX, an indicator of market volatility, decreased. This suggests reduced investor fear and uncertainty, aligning with the positive movements seen in the S&P 500 and Nasdaq Composite.

mortgage.why: The 30-year fixed mortgage rate, as reported in a weekly survey released November 25, decreased by 0.07%. The articles do not provide specific reasons for this weekly change, but mortgage rates generally track the direction of 10-year Treasury yields over recent days, which were trending upwards on November 27.

policy_upcoming.what_happened: Temporary regulations were issued concerning a new nonrefundable Federal tax credit for qualified contributions to scholarship granting organizations.
policy_upcoming.effect: A new nonrefundable Federal tax credit becomes available for qualified contributions to scholarship granting organizations in 2027 and later taxable years.

policy_upcoming.what_happened: Final rules set forth requirements for price transparency reporting for non-grandfathered group health plans and health insurance issuers.
policy_upcoming.effect: Your employer health insurance plan has new price transparency reporting requirements that become effective on December 7, 2026.

policy_upcoming.what_happened: This final rule revises HUD's Section 214 regulations for verifying eligible status.
policy_upcoming.effect: You must verify U.S. citizenship or eligible immigration status if you apply for housing assistance under a covered program.

policy_upcoming.what_happened: A Utah bill modifies provisions related to the property tax exemption process.
policy_upcoming.effect: Once you own a home, you will have deadlines for filing an application for a property tax exemption with the county board of equalization and for the board to render a decision.

policy_upcoming.what_happened: A bill amends requirements for health insurance preauthorization in Utah.
policy_upcoming.effect: Your health insurer must make an authorization or adverse preauthorization determination within a defined maximum time.

policy_week.what_happened: This final rule revises HUD's Section 214 regulations for verifying eligible status.
policy_week.effect: You must verify U.S. citizenship or eligible immigration status if you apply for housing assistance under a covered program.

policy_calendar.label: FHFA set the 2027 baseline conforming loan limit at $855,400 for one-unit homes, announced Nov 24
policy_calendar.note: Up $22,650 from 2026. It applies to loans made from January 1, 2027, and is the line between a conforming mortgage and a jumbo one in most of the US. High-cost counties have higher limits on FHFA's county list.

tech.summary: Malicious GGUF LLM models containing hidden malware have affected approximately 2,400 victims on Hugging Face.
Google's DeepCrossAttention technique has achieved comparable model quality while running up to three times faster than previous methods.
A project called Unkernel allows the real Linux kernel to be compiled to WebAssembly, demonstrating new possibilities for operating system deployment.

world.summary: Taiwan's ruling Democratic Progressive Party achieved its strongest performance in a decade during local elections, nearly doubling its control of constituencies, an outcome likely to provoke Beijing.
An explosion in Afghanistan, attributed to carelessness at an explosives depot, killed 10 students and injured over 100 people.

us.summary: A powerful storm impacted the East Coast, causing widespread power outages and travel disruptions, while Black Friday sales were predicted to reach record levels despite rising energy prices.

California voters passed a ballot measure proposed by a billionaire to fund $8.4 billion in immunology research, with half of the allocation going to a research group supported by the same individual.

science.summary: A cheaper HIV prevention jab, Lenacapavir, which is nearly 100% effective and administered twice a year, is now being introduced in Africa, offering hope to millions.
Health officials in England are urging those at risk to get vaccinated immediately due to a surge in severe flu cases and a warning from an NHS boss about a 'horrible spike' in hospital admissions.
